hints.tr: Bu sefer `import statistics` değil, fonksiyonları doğrudan alıyorsun: `from statistics import ...`. İki fonksiyonu virgülle ayırarak tek satırda alabilirsin.
hints.en: This time you are not writing `import statistics`; you take the functions directly with `from statistics import ...`. You can take both on one line, separated by a comma.

hints.tr: Doğrudan aldığın için önlerine `statistics.` koymuyorsun: `mean(scores)` ve `median(scores)` yeterli.
hints.en: Since you took them directly you do not put `statistics.` in front: `mean(scores)` and `median(scores)` are enough.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
from statistics import mean, median

scores = [70, 85, 90, 60, 95, 80]

average = mean(scores)
middle = median(scores)

print(average)
print(middle)
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
from statistics import mean, median

scores = [70, 85, 90, 60, 95, 80]

average = mean(scores)
middle = median(scores)

print(average)
print(middle)
```

hint.tr: `from statistics import ...` biçimini kullanman gerekiyor. Bu alıştırmanın konusu tam olarak bu biçim.
hint.en: You need to use the `from statistics import ...` form. That form is exactly what this exercise is about.
